history.sg_progress: Please refer to number 33 in annex II to the Board’s report A/80/5 (Vol. II) for the Administration’s comments. The simulation of the distribution of health insurance costs is conducted once a year as part of the health insurance annual renewal procedure. The updated process will be utilized between March and April 2026. Related internal control elements for the initiation of updated rates and subsequent monitoring controls will also be put into place during the first half of the year, with finalization of the related formal documentation planned for completion during the third quarter of 2026.
